notes.title: Don’t Be Afraid 2 Patch 1.1 is HERE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851039/ab3cb383d91dc174833d801854fd7b5b8c76b863.png[/img]

The launch of [b]Don’t Be Afraid 2[/b] was a great joy for us and we want to [b]thank you for your support and feedback[/b]. We’ve been hard at work since, listening to you closely so that we could improve your experience even further.

[hr][/hr]

[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] fixed a bug that made solving the last puzzle in the Attic level impossible
[*] Sometimes David got so excited that his voice lines overlapped. That no longer happens.
[*] Menu turning off the controls bug is fixed
[/list]
[b]General Improvements:
[/b]
[list]
[*] You will notice multiple new blood-pumping jumpscares in different locations. No spoilers though…
[*] Flashlight: the beam is wider, with improved gamma
[*] batteries last longer
[/list]
[u][b]Room-specific improvements:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Attic: improved clarity of symbols on the stone circle
[*] Police Room: added multiple hints scattered around, your flashlight in UV mode will make solving these puzzles much easier; UV-sensitive numbers near the fingerprints clarity improved
[*] Tunnels/ Final level: added flashlight batteries at the beginning of the level
[/list]
[u][b]Languages:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] added Chinese Traditional language support
[*] added Japanese language support
[*] added Korean language support
[/list]

Your feedback and support were invaluable. We’re already working on further improvements and if you have any suggestions, feel free to drop them. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631880/Dont_Be_Afraid_2/

notes.title: Don't Be Afraid 2 - The release date is revealed.
notes.notes:
[i]“Hello, David… It's been a long time, hasn't it? I’ve got a new game for you…”[/i]

Fifteen years passed since David escaped the maze of torment, but the wounds of the mind are slow to heal. We are thrilled to announce that [b]Don’t Be Afraid 2[/b] will be [b]launching [/b]on [b]October 28th 2024[/b].

[previewyoutube=tKpYBySuQZo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Prepare yourself[/b] to enter the labyrinth of fear, where the darkness lurking in one’s mind is only one of the many dangers… [b]Mark your calendars [/b]and [i]always [/i]- and we cannot stress this enough - [b]always keep your flashlight charged[/b].

More terrors will resurface soon.[b] Wishlist the game here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631880/Dont_Be_Afraid_2/
